column1: The roads in our area need urgent repairs.
School libraries should have more books for students.
Students in rural areas need better access to quality education.
More scholarships are needed for students from low-income families.
Teachers need better training in modern teaching methods.
Pedestrians need safer crossings near busy roads.
There are dark areas near the park because street lights are missing.
Traffic safety measures are needed near schools.
The damaged street lights should be repaired quickly.
More CCTV cameras are needed in crowded public areas.
Road crossings need proper signs and warning lights.
